skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recall terminology related to real estate markets, brokerage, valuation, management, investment, and finance.
Understand how to translate and extract information from real estate-related documents in English.
Apply vocabulary to write reports, participate in discussions, and present issues related to real estate in English.
Read and comprehend real estate-related materials using skimming and scanning techniques.
Prepare and deliver group presentations on real estate topics.
Analyze and evaluate real estate-related problems critically.
Work effectively in teams and individually on real estate projects.
Demonstrate responsibility in individual and team work in real estate contexts.
Identify and fulfill social and professional ethical responsibilities when making judgments and evaluations in real estate.
